section_summary.extract_value: This is a Measures section describing the instruments used in the study. The study assessed drive for muscularity using the Drive for Muscularity Scale (DMS; 15 items), body appreciation using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; 13 items), Big Five personality domains using the NEO-FFI (60 items), subjective social status using the McArthur Ladder, and demographic information including self-reported height and weight for BMI calculation. The text references 'the present study' and 'the present work,' suggesting a single study design.
